plugin.name: Climatology
plugin.summary: Climatology PlugIn: global monthly climate and cyclone data
plugin.author: Sean D'Epagnier
plugin.description: Climatology provides overlay capabilities for historical weather and ocean data. Supported types include average wind direction and speed, gale and calm probabilities, sea-surface currents, precipitation, humidity, cloud cover, lightning strikes, sea-level pressure, sea and air temperature, and tropical-cyclone tracks. Versioned datasets report their exact source products and climatological periods.
